claims: Configuration-fixed constrained triaxial RMF calculations with PK1 demonstrate stable triaxial minima in 74,76,78,80,82Br and 76,78,80,82,84,86Rb supporting candidate chiral doublet bands and MchiD.

As neutron number N increases from 39 to 47 in the Br isotopic chain, the neutron Fermi level approaches the top of the g9/2 subshell, increasing hole purity and stabilizing chiral geometry, which explains the monotonic decrease of experimental energy splitting Delta E(I).

Experimental discoveries in 74As (Z=33) and 84Rb (Z=37) extend the proton boundaries of the A~80 chiral island, while 81Kr demonstrates that chiral doublet bands can also manifest in odd-A nuclei with 3-quasiparticle configurations.

The observation of two pairs of opposite-parity chiral doublet bands connected by eight enhanced E1 transitions in 78Br and 76Br demonstrates the coexistence and mutual catalysis of nuclear chirality and octupole correlations (chiral-parity quartets).
74Br provides the first experimental evidence of a chiral wobbler, establishing that nuclear chirality remains robust against transverse wobbling excitations.
